metadata.title: 🔤 G4.7 RichText Rendering Foundation Architecture v0.1
metadata.text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3e04c57a590c81b9b775e7e18fe8439d as of 2026-09-19T15:35:00.034Z: {"title":"G4.7 RichText Rendering Foundation Architecture v0.1"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🔤"} **Status: G4.7 Architecture Design Baseline.** 本页定义 G4.6 PASS 之后、G5 Large Canvas Optimization 之前的 **RichText Rendering Foundation**。目标不是提前实现 G6 Rich Editing，而是把 RichText 的 production display/layout/font-resource workload 在 G5 之前 materialize，使 G5 的 Damage / RenderGroup / Tile / Scheduler / ResourceBudget 能针对真实 text workload 做统一优化。 # 0. Role / Authority / Scope **Role:** G4.7 RichText Rendering Foundation / P14–P18 architecture baseline。 **Immediate upstream:** Gate PASS。 **Immediate downstream:** 。 **Semantic / runtime authority consumed:** - - - - - - ，仅消费 display/editing separation；不提前实现 IME。 - 的 Direct / NonTiled reference path 与 RichText ObjectKind renderer coverage。 # 1. Why G4.7 Exists 当前 authority chain 存在一个 execution-order gap： G3 → RichText 已进入 RuntimeScene / Direct Canonical Render kind coverage → G5 即将优化 Damage / Cache / Tile / Scheduler / ResourceBudget，且 engineering authority 已考虑 glyph/text resources → 旧路线 G6-01 才 materialize Production RichText Model/Layout Service 这意味着如果不插入 G4.7，G5 可能在没有 production text shaping/layout/font workload 的情况下完成架构规模验证，然后 G6 才首次引入真实 paragraph/run/style layout、font materialization、glyph workload、text layout invalidation、many-small-label / long-text workload。 G4.7 只修复这个 execution-order gap；**不改变 RichText canonical semantics，不改变 G6 editing ownership。** # 2. Gate Objective > **在 G5 前建立 renderer-neutral、resource-aware、incremental-observable 的 production RichText layout/display path，并冻结可 replay 的 text workload。** G4.7 必须证明： 1. canonical RichText → derived layout → RuntimeScene/Render 的 ownership 闭合； 2. font resource missing/ready 不改变 canonical state，只改变 derived layout/render readiness； 3. text content/style edit 可以局部 invalidate derived layout，而 transform/camera-only change 不触发 text re-layout； 4. Direct / NonTiled reference path 能继续作为 G5 optimized text rendering 的 correctness oracle； 5. G5 获得真实 glyph/layout/resource/cache 压力，而不是 static placeholder text。 # 3. Hard Boundary — What G4.7 Does NOT Move Forward G4.7 **不提前实现 G6 Rich Editing**。以下仍属于 G6： - TextEditSession lifecycle； - caret / text selection local state； - IME composition； - EditorProjection； - Unicode scalar ↔ platform UTF-16/DOM position mapping； - Windows/Web/Android native text adapters； - platform editor overlay； - Clipboard； - ExternalSurface； - platform lifecycle / surface-device recovery orchestration。 同时不新增 RichText canonical width/height field、TextBox ObjectKind、Table ObjectKind / cell model、bidi paragraph-direction schema、collaboration OT/CRDT。 # 4. Ownership Boundary
State / Capability Owner Canonical?
RichTextDocument / Paragraph / TextRun / TextStyle / ParagraphStyle Semantic Core Yes
EditRichText / RichTextDelta apply Semantic Core / Operation Engine Yes
RichText layout/shaping result Axiom Text Runtime No — derived/discardable
RichText bounds / spatial contribution Scene Core consuming Text Runtime layout No — derived
FontResourceId semantic identity Semantic Schema Yes
Font bytes custody / local availability Shared Data Runtime BlobManager / Resource contract No canonical content mutation
Exact face resolution / runtime font materialization Axiom Resource + Text Runtime No
Glyph atlas / GPU text resource Render backend / G5 ResourceBudget No
Text RenderSource / composition Render Core No
IME/caret/editor overlay G6 Interaction + Platform Host No
# 5. Module Topology SemanticDocument @ G → RichTextDocument → SceneCompiler / RichText Scene Provider → Axiom Text Runtime - RichTextLayoutService - TextShapingProfile - FontFaceResolver - derived TextLayoutSnapshot → Scene Core - local/visual/world bounds - dependency metadata - spatial contribution → RuntimeScene @ G → Render Core - Direct / NonTiled Reference Source - Text RenderSource - IRenderBackend → Skia private backend → Canonical Surface Resource side-path： TextStyle.fontResourceId → Resource availability / integrity → FontResource materialization → exact (weight, italic) face resolution → TextLayout invalidation/rebuild **Invariant:** Render Core normal frame path不得读取 SemanticDocument；RichText semantic→runtime conversion仍通过 SceneCompiler / accepted runtime boundary完成。 # 6. RichTextLayoutService Contract G4.7 建立 renderer-neutral Text Runtime service。Exact C++ ABI 在 P31 时按 repo reconciliation 冻结，但能力至少包括： **Layout input** - canonical RichText content/read projection； - accepted runtime layout constraint/context； - font resource generation / availability； - text stack profile。 **Layout output** - local text bounds； - paragraph/line fragments； - shaped render runs； - mapping needed by future editing geometry； - dependency/resource observations； - revision/generation metadata。 Rules： - output 100% derived/discardable； - no Skia object / native font handle in stable Scene/Public contract； - same accepted font bytes + same RichText input + same layout context + same text-stack profile must produce reference-equivalent layout； - transform-only / camera-only changes reuse local text layout； - font Materialized/Evicted is derived resource state, not EditRichText； - missing/corrupt/exact-face-unavailable follows existing font authority；禁止 OS/browser fallback 改变 canonical rendering meaning。 # 7. Layout Constraint / Text Box Safety Boundary 当前 V1 RichTextContent 只有 document；现有 authority **没有冻结 standalone RichText canonical width/height 或完整 TextBox wrapping policy**。 因此 G4.7 明确： - 不新增 RichText width/height； - 不用 implementation branch 发明 TextBox semantic； - layout service 可以接受 runtime LayoutContext / Constraint，但约束来源必须来自已接受的 object/container/runtime authority或 verification harness； - standalone RichText 的产品 wrapping/sizing policy若在 P31 时仍无 accepted authority，必须保持当前 accepted reference behavior，不在 G4.7 偷偷冻结新 semantic； - Sticky/未来 Table/Shape label 的 constraint source 必须由各自 semantic/container authority提供。 这不是 G4.7 blocker，只要 production display path能够在当前已接受约束下形成 deterministic reference workload；任何需要新 canonical sizing field 的发现必须 route 到 upstream Product/Object/Schema review。 # 8. Text Stack / Shaping Profile 现有 RichText Font authority已明确：TextStyle不携带 HarfBuzz/SkShaper/SkParagraph version，production renderer使用统一 Axiom text stack/profile。 G4.7 因此冻结 **runtime compatibility profile boundary**，不把 engine version写入 canonical schema。 Candidate internal stack可消费当前 locked R1 Full Skia SDK： - SkParagraph； - SkShaper； - SkUnicode； - HarfBuzz； - ICU。 但稳定 contracts保持 renderer-neutral；升级 text stack需要 conformance/golden review。 Bidi / explicit paragraph direction仍按上游 authority保持 OPEN / deferred，不在本 Gate制造新 schema。 # 9. Revision / Invalidation Model 至少区分以下 derived validity facts；exact field names可在 implementation时调整： - RichText content revision； - Layout-context revision； - Font materialization generation； - Text-stack/profile revision； - Render/Glyph resource generation。 典型路径： - EditRichText → content revision changes → affected text layout invalid → local bounds/visual contribution update → SceneDelta → Render Damage。 - SetTransforms → world transform/bounds update → **NO local text re-layout**。 - Camera / Zoom → per-view visibility/raster scale changes → **NO SemanticGeneration change / NO local text re-layout**。 - Font Missing → Ready → resource generation changes → affected text layout/render invalidation → **NO Operation / NO SemanticGeneration mutation**。 # 10. Render Integration G4.7 必须保留两条路径： - TextLayoutSnapshot → Direct / NonTiled Reference； - TextLayoutSnapshot → production RenderSource → Skia backend。 G5 后续可以增加 RenderGroup、RasterCache、Tile、glyph/resource admission、scheduler priority，但 G5 不能重新定义 text layout semantics，也不能让 cache hit/miss影响 correctness。 # 11. Pre-G5 Performance Primitive Inventory
Primitive Pre-G5 source Status / G4.7 action
Basic Shape / Vector / canonical render G3 Covered upstream
Image / resource decode-materialization 07-13 + G3/resource path **Execution readiness must be audited in G4.7-00**；若 post-G4.6 repo没有 replayable production image/resource workload，G4.7必须 fail closed并创建窄 Architecture/Execution follow-up，不得让 G5只用 fake/static image placeholder。
Ink / interaction G4 Covered upstream
Programmable brush / textured dabs / soft alpha / Laser G4.5 Covered upstream
Selection / transform / viewport / snap overlay G4.6 Covered upstream
RichText shaping/layout/font/glyph workload G4.7 **This Gate closes current gap**
Table semantic/layout Future Object Model Not implemented before G5；use dense structured-grid proxy workload only
ExternalSurface / native editor overlay G6 Deferred；not a canonical canvas-raster prerequisite for G5
# 12. G5 Workload Families G4.7 必须冻结至少： - text-many-small：many independent short RichText objects / labels； - text-long：long paragraph/run content under accepted layout context； - text-style-mixed：many style runs / exact font faces / underline/color variation； - text-edit-local：deterministic EditRichText burst on one/few visible objects； - text-font-cold-warm：font resource Missing/Ready or cold/warm materialization； - text-transform：move/rotate/scale RichText without local relayout； - text-camera：pan/zoom over dense text without semantic/layout mutation； - structured-grid-proxy：dense Shape + RichText cell-like composition，performance proxy only，**NOT Table semantic object**。 Metrics至少包括： - object / paragraph / run / Unicode scalar count； - layout requests / cache hit-miss； - shaping/layout CPU time； - affected-object / affected-layout count； - glyph/run count； - font resource materialization bytes/generations； - local bounds / damage footprint； - render commands； - frame p50/p95/p99 observations； - deterministic layout/reference digest where stable。 # 13. Future Table Compatibility Contract G4.7 不实现 Table，但为未来 structured objects要求三条边界： 1. RichText layout必须可被 container/table layout以明确 LayoutContext 调用，而不是读取 Product Shell state； 2. G5 的 GeometryChunk / Damage / RenderGroup / Tile 不允许硬编码 ObjectKind::RichText 或未来 ObjectKind::Table 才能工作； 3. dense structured-grid proxy必须进入 G5 benchmark corpus，验证“大量小矩形 + 大量小 RichText”不会要求重做 G5 基础架构。 未来 Table 自己负责 cell identity、row/column layout、merge、range selection、formula等 semantic/layout policy，然后向通用 Scene/Render pipeline报告局部 derived contribution。 # 14. Physical / Cross-platform Checkpoint G4.7 在 production Render integration完成后必须有 **early physical checkpoint**，不等 Gate 尾部才第一次看真实文字。 Windows / Web / Android 至少验证： - same bundled FontResource exact face； - small/large text； - mixed weights/styles； - 25% / 100% / 400% zoom； - DPR / resize； - long/dense text； - missing font resource degraded path； - cold→ready font transition无 canonical mutation； - no obvious layout jump between reference and production path。 Raster anti-aliasing允许平台/backend容差，但 layout/reference semantics必须按 accepted text profile对账。 # 15. Gate Exit Invariants G4.7 PASS 至少要求： - G4.6 Gate PASS； - production RichTextLayoutService exists； - semantic→layout→Scene/Render path uses accepted ownership； - exact FontResource face policy PASS； - no OS/browser implicit font fallback； - transform/camera-only changes cause zero local text relayout； - EditRichText locality evidence exists； - font Missing→Ready causes derived invalidation only； - Direct/NonTiled text reference path remains runnable； - Tier-A physical checkpoint PASS； - dense structured-grid proxy workload frozen； - Pre-G5 Performance Primitive Inventory has no unresolved hidden primitive gap；Image/Resource row either proven replayable or blocks G4.7 with explicit follow-up； - deterministic G5 RichText workload corpus frozen； - G3/G4/G4.5/G4.6 regressions PASS。 # 16. Handoff G4.6 PASS → G4.7 RichText Rendering Foundation PASS → G5 Large Canvas Optimization → G6 Rich Editing + Platform Lifecycle G5 must consume G4.7 layout/font/glyph workloads。G6 must consume the same G4.7 production layout service and **must not create a second RichText layout stack**。
